description: This file implements the GrokLLMService class, which extends OpenAILLMService to interact with Grok's API using an OpenAI-compatible interface. It includes token usage tracking, context aggregation, and deprecated context aggregator pair management.

classes.name: GrokContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: A deprecated container class for pairing user and assistant context aggregators for Grok LLM interactions.

classes.name: GrokLLMService
classes.description: A service class for interacting with Grok's API using an OpenAI-compatible interface, with token usage tracking and context aggregation.

methods.name: user
methods.description: Returns the user context aggregator instance.

methods.name: assistant
methods.description: Returns the assistant context aggregator instance.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the GrokLLMService with API key, base URL, and model.

methods.name: create_client
methods.description: Creates an OpenAI-compatible client for Grok API endpoint.

methods.name: _process_context
methods.description: Processes a context through the LLM, accumulating token usage metrics.

methods.name: start_llm_usage_metrics
methods.description: Accumulates token usage metrics during processing, reporting totals at the end.

methods.name: create_context_aggregator
methods.description: Creates a GrokContextAggregatorPair from an OpenAILLMContext, deprecated in favor of universal LLMContext.
